title: Mathematical & Algorithmic Foundations of AI
description: Rigorous mathematical and computational foundations for modern artificial intelligence, machine learning, and deep neural architectures.

steps.note: Vector spaces, SVD, matrix decompositions, and low-rank approximation.
Multivariate gradients, Hessians, and unconstrained optimization.
Joint distributions, expectation, variance, and concentration inequalities.
Maximum likelihood estimation, Bayesian inference, and hypothesis testing.
Asymptotic analysis, divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, and graph algorithms.
Shannon entropy, mutual information, and Kullback-Leibler divergence.
Supervised and unsupervised models, loss functions, regularization, and generalization bounds.
Backpropagation, transformers, attention mechanisms, and gradient dynamics.
